bodyNormalization: Unicode NFKC followed by removal of Unicode whitespace; preserve punctuation and digits. Concatenate body items in reference order. Include narrative prose inside teaching-table cells; table row/column correctness is scored separately. Exclude formula spans, purely numeric data-table cells, figure labels and page furniture. Compare the corresponding body projection of model output, not the full mixed page string.
formulaUnit: One complete expression or relation with its visible conditions. Mathematically equivalent LaTeX is accepted. Do not split a fraction, cases expression or equality chain into sub-tokens. Table formulas are also present in formulas and referenced by their cell.
tableUnit: One visible logical cell, including header or blank cell, at its original row/column and spans. Cross-page cells contain only visible text; continuation IDs link the pieces. Cell text plus referenced formulas form the cell reference.
blockUnit: Each frozen body paragraph, complete formula, table region and figure region. Bounding boxes are page pixels [left,top,right,bottom]. Overlap between an inline formula and its paragraph is intentional.
figurePolicy: Preserve the source figure and a locatable region. The listed source labels must remain visible in the retained source image or equivalent output. Vector reconstruction is not required. Systematic loss of critical labels eliminates the route.
hardFailures: systematic loss of critical figure labels
reporting: Report numerator and denominator per page and per category; no mixed total score. Aggregate repeated-source content by contentGroup as well as page, so source variants never create extra independent evidence.
damagedInput: F is excluded from all ordinary quality and latency denominators. Report visible-content retention, invented content and failure behavior separately.
referenceOrigin: Original page images or the new author source only. No old OCR raw, result or markdown outputs were consulted.
